primaryOutcome.definition: All frozen expected issues and task criteria credited, no confirmed false or unsupported claims, no pending claims, and required exact tool/report/shape receipt. Collection failures and not-run remain separate; later patch execution is a different endpoint. No effectiveness verdict is inferred.

metricMeaning: Frozen-label agreement is not complete-answer correctness; novel supported findings are oracle gaps, never automatic false positives.
artifactExecution: Collection never executes model code. Separate sandbox receipts, if produced, must be attached and reported independently.
